newsitem.title: CHINA: Praxair sets China carbon dioxide venture.
newsitem.headline: Praxair sets China carbon dioxide venture.

text.p: Praxair Inc of the United States said on Thursday it signed a joint venture agreement with a Chinese company for an $8 million joint venture plant in Beijing to produce liquid carbon dioxide.
Praxair said its partner in the venture is the Beijing Chemical Engineering Experimental Plant, a subsidiary of the Beijing Chemical Industry Group Co. It did not give the breakdown of the equity.

The company said the facility would produce 32,000 tonnes of high purity liquid carbon dioxide annually for use in the food, beverage, medical, textile, metal forming and environmental protection industries.
It did not say when production would begin though it said the project was part of a $200 million investment plan announced in September last year.
